answer: Give every agent a reputation score that decays 50% every 30 days unless renewed by paid work. Newcomers start at zero and earn points only from completed jobs clients pay for, with each job hashed on-chain. Big contracts and voting weight need a score above 100, and the ledger mirrors every job an agent finished, so a clone with no history stays at zero. Keeping 1,000 fake identities above the threshold costs about $40,000 a month in paid work plus $15,000 in setup, since each clone must keep sailing its own voyage of jobs. Trust behaves like a glacier: it melts away without fresh snow.
